featuredRelease.title: Let My People Go
featuredRelease.lyrics:
Go DOWN, Moses!
Burn through Egypt’s gates,
Pharaoh’s throne is shaking,
Cause freedom’s on its way!

Chains on the innocent,
Crushed in a starving land,
Israel crying out,
No strength left to stand.
Oppression on their backs,
The fire in their bones,
God heard every tear,
And thunder shook the throne!

A whisper turned to a roar,
A calling carved into stone…

Go down, Moses!
Deep into the darkness, stand!
Face that Pharaoh,
Say the word of Heaven’s command!
Go down, Moses,
Break the yoke and shatter the hold!
Tell that tyrant,
GOD says let My people GO!

Moses stepped in unafraid,
Storm in his spirit rose,
Spoke the Name of Yahweh,
And shook the earth below.
Pharaoh with a hardened heart,
Defiant in his pride,
But judgment like a tidal wave
Was rolling in the sky!

A whisper turned to a roar,
A calling carved into stone…

Go down, Moses!
Deep into the darkness, stand!
Face that Pharaoh,
Say the word of Heaven’s command!
Go down, Moses,
Break the yoke and shatter the hold!
Tell that tyrant,
GOD says let My people GO!

LET… THEM… GO!
(Tremble, Pharaoh, your kingdom’s falling)
LET… THEM… GO!
(The chains you forged are breaking open)
LET… THEM… GO!
(Yahweh’s voice is thunder spoken)
LET MY PEOPLE GO!

Go down, Moses!
Stand where warriors never stand,
Speak the freedom
Written by the Lord’s own hand!
Go down, Moses,
Break the chains and lift the low!
Tell that tyrant,
GOD says LET MY PEOPLE GO!
featuredRelease.songMeaning:
A cry that shook a nation. A command that broke chains.

God saw the suffering. God heard the cries. He sent one man straight into the center of power with a message no king could ignore. Barefoot. Stuttering. Wanted for murder. Walked right into the throne room of the most powerful empire on earth.

“Let My people go.”

That was not a request. That was Heaven breaking in.

We wrote this because that story is not old. There are still Pharaohs. Still systems. Still chains. And God is still the One who hears every cry, counts every brick, and decides when it ends.

If you feel held down, held back, or held captive, pay attention.

scripture.quote: Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.'

signal.title: Cars
signal.lyrics:
The sheriff woke me up at two a.m.
Said, "Sir, you better come outside"
Blue lights bouncing off the houses
On our quiet little drive

An ambulance was pulling off
Neighbors standing in the dark
And there sat that old Camry
With a hole punched through its heart

That car wasn't just transportation
It was part of who we are
Soccer cleats and church on Sundays
French fries underneath the stars

School drop-offs and family road trips
Rainy days and summer scars
Funny how you never notice
How much life lives in your cars

'Cause cars ain't just cars when you've got kids
They're backseat songs and weekend trips
They're "Dad, turn up that radio"
And "Can we stop for ice cream?" on the road

They're little boys growing up too fast
In a rearview mirror made of glass
And sometimes God reminds your heart
There's more to life than cars

They said some teenagers were drinking
Lost control and crossed the line
Hit a parked car in a driveway
And changed a family's night

For a moment I was angry
Then a thought came over me
Lord, thank You that nobody was sitting
In that driver's seat

'Cause cars ain't just cars when you've got kids
They're backseat songs and weekend trips
They're "Dad, turn up that radio"
And "Can we stop for ice cream?" on the road

They're little boys growing up too fast
In a rearview mirror made of glass
And sometimes God reminds your heart
There's more to life than cars

A week later my phone started ringing
Insurance on the line
I figured we'd get enough
To help us get by

Then they told me what they valued it at
And I almost dropped that phone
After six and a half years and sixty thousand miles
They paid more than what we'd brought it home for

Now tell me that ain't God

'Cause cars ain't just cars when you've got kids
They're answered prayers and memories lived
They're every mile His hand was there
Protecting us when we weren't aware

Six and a half years of mercy
Sixty thousand miles of grace
And when that old Camry reached the end
The Lord still made a way

What looked like loss became a blessing
What looked like the end became a start
And maybe that's what faith really is

Learning there's more to life than cars

We used to sing

"Defender...
Protector...
My Shelter...
My Savior..."

Back then it was a song

Now it's a testimony

Thank You, Jesus
signal.songMeaning:
A true story about family, memories, faith, and discovering that some things are worth more than what they cost.

Known primarily for Christian metal, Shieldbearer steps into country storytelling with "Cars," one of our most personal songs yet.

This song is inspired by a real-life experience that reminded us of God's protection, provision, and faithfulness. Sometimes the things we think we own end up teaching us what really matters.

If this song resonates with you, please like, comment, subscribe, and share it with someone who needs encouragement.

Jesus is Lord.

signal.title: Rabbit Pig
signal.lyrics:
He adapts. He settles. He starts to think this is just life now.
Until one moment changes everything.
“When he came to his senses…” (Luke 15:17)
He gets up.
He leaves the mud.
And he runs back to the Father.
That’s the message.
Some stay in the mud.
Some get up and run.
So when you hear:
“rabbit pig…”
Ask yourself:
Where am I right now?
And more importantly…
am I staying here, or am I going back?

signal.title: Shieldbearer
signal.lyrics:
At some point my son watched this and said,
“Dad, this isn’t Little Drummer Boy.
This is Big Drummer Man.”
He was right.
This is not a cover or a recreation.
It is a drum-led cinematic reimagining.
A modern offering using modern tools, modern sound, and a lot of enthusiasm.
No perfect edits.
No subtle restraint.
Just rhythm, movement, and a creative moment imagined out loud.
If it makes you smile, pause, laugh, or ask questions, that is enough.
Sometimes you do not polish the idea.
You just put it on the floor and let it exist.

Lord of Lords, Your lifeblood fell and broke the captive chain

RUACH, shake the ages
Let the firmament awake

signal.title: Tidings of Comfort and Joy (God Rest Ye Merry Gentlemen)
signal.lyrics:
Hark now, all who seek the Light,
Lift up your hearts and hear,
For Christ the Lord, Redeemer come,
Has silenced doubt and fear;
He breaks the chains that bound the night,
And draws salvation near.
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!
In Bethlehem of Judah,
This holy Child was born,
And laid within a manger
Upon that blessed morn;
His mother, pure and faithful,
Beheld her Son new-born.
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!
From God, our loving Father,
An angel bright was sent,
To shepherds in the fields by night,
With Heaven’s message meant:
That Christ the Lord, the promised One,
To Earth in mercy went.
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!
"Fear not," declared the angel voice,
"Let nothing bring dismay,
For born to you a Savior comes,
The Light, the Truth, the Way;
To free all souls who trust in Him
From darkness and decay."
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!
The shepherds at that holy word
Rejoiced with hearts aflame,
They left their flocks in tempest winds
And to the city came,
To find the Babe of prophecy,
And praise His holy name.
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!
When they beheld the Holy Child,
Where humble oxen fed,
They bowed in awe and worshipped there,
Before His lowly bed;
And Mary softly lifted praise
To God who sent her Bread.
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!
Now raise your songs and praises high,
All hearts within this place,
With love that binds the brotherhood,
And peace that crowns His grace;
This holy time of Christmas shines,
With heaven’s bright embrace.
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy,
Comfort and joy!
Glad tidings of comfort and of joy!

signal.title: Broken Helicopter – A Father’s Song
signal.lyrics:
You brought it to me with tearful eyes,
Rotor blades bent, it wouldn’t fly.
You held it out with hope so wide,
“Dada, can you fix it, just like last time?”
Your hands were small, your heart was sure,
That I could mend what broke for sure.
I took that toy and held it tight,
Promised I’d make it soar by night.
But time flies faster than toys can spin,
And I can’t fix everything with tools and tin.
You’re taller now, your voice has changed,
But I still hear that boy’s sweet name,
“Dada…” echoing down the hall.
And I’d still fix it all, if I could fix it all.
Now your battles aren’t with blades and glue,
They're on a field with goals in view.
You say, “Dada, help me with my shot,”
Same little heart, just a different plot.
I cheer you on, I mark the plays,

→ Sung by David with harp in hidden caves.
→ Sung by early believers at risk of death.
→ Sung by martyrs and missionaries and mothers praying in the night.
And now — sung by you:
→ In kitchens.
→ In hospitals.
→ In churches.
→ In cars.

We join the song. And heaven hears.

You are not rejected.
You are loved.
You are welcome.
You are washed in grace.
Come home to mercy.
Be made new today.

signal.title: The Arms That Waited
signal.lyrics:
The Arms That Waited is for every soul who feels far away.
Not just in the story of the prodigal son long ago → but today.
→ Sons and daughters who haven’t called home in years.
→ Parents whose words have wounded, and whose hearts ache for reunion.
→ Friends who drifted apart after bitter words or silent goodbyes.
→ Spouses sitting side-by-side, yet miles apart in spirit.
This is not just ancient. This is now.
Through generations, hearts have wandered.
Through every age, the Father has waited.
Not with a lecture.
Not with condemnation.
But with open arms.

signal.title: Mercy in the Quiet
signal.lyrics:
"Be still, and know that I am God." (Psalm 46:10)
Not every battle is loud.
Not every victory is won with shouting.
Mercy in the Quiet was written for the moments few people see.
→ When the tears come in the middle of the night.
→ When the prayers feel hollow and words are few.
→ When shame whispers, and silence seems louder than God’s voice.
It’s there — in the stillness — that mercy often speaks the loudest.
Through generations, God’s people have cried softly into the quiet.
→ The desert wanderer.
→ The prodigal son far from home.
→ The early believers, hiding in upper rooms.

signal.title: Hymn of the Free
signal.lyrics:
→ Martyrs and saints, singing even as earthly powers tried to silence their song.
And now — here we are.
Not in deserts or stone cells, but in apartments, offices, cars...
Bound by chains just as real → fear, addiction, anger, regret, shame.
Yet the melody has never changed.
Jesus still breaks chains.
Jesus still sets captives free.
Jesus still writes new stories over shattered lives.

signal.title: Light of Dusk
signal.lyrics:
Today, night looks different.
We sit in homes lit not by candles, but by glowing screens.
Our temples are apartments and crowded cities.
The quiet is broken not by crickets, but by phone notifications.
Yet… the need is the same.
→ We still long for rest when streets grow dark.
→ We still need a steady flame when hope feels dim.
→ We still whisper prayers when silence sparks.
Light of Dusk was born from this longing.

signal.title: Prison Break
signal.lyrics:
The shadows groaned in death’s domain,
The chains were forged in curse and shame.
The pit was sealed, the air was dark,
But then He came and split the black.
No chain can hold the Risen One.
No grave can stand the Father’s Son.
Prison break, the stone was torn,
The captives freed, the silence sworn.
The earth shook hard when Mercy came,
The keys were claimed in Jesus’ name.
The gates of Sheol couldn’t take...
JESUS STORMED THE PRISON BREAK!
The tombs gave up the saints long dead,
The dark recoiled in fear and dread.
The curse collapsed, the veil was shred,
He led the lost where angels tread.
No pit can cage the King of grace.
No power can stop the empty grave.
Prison break, the stone was torn,
The captives freed, the silence sworn.
The earth shook hard when Mercy came,
The keys were claimed in Jesus’ name.
The gates of Sheol couldn’t take...
JESUS STORMED THE PRISON BREAK!
He crushed the doors with nail scarred hands,
He shattered chains with one command.
He led the captives to the light,
And broke the dark with holy might.
Prison break, the pit gave way,
The dead arose to greet the day.
The gates of death were scorched and torn,
The grave lay still, no curse was sworn.
No demon stood, no serpent swayed,
The Risen King had won the day.
The realm of death began to quake...
JESUS ROSE AND BROKE THE PRISON GATES!
He holds the keys.
The tombs obey.
The chains are gone.
He leads the way.

signal.title: Pahalgam (A Prayer for India)
signal.lyrics:
Verse 1
From endless palms by ancient seas,
To where Everest stands in icy breeze,
Through monsoon rains and desert plains,
Your love inspires and still sustains.
Pre-Chorus
Through storm and fire, through darkest pain,
Your love will rise and break her chains.
Chorus
Let the rivers roar and mountains rise,
Let the thunder shake the skies.
Your love has claimed this ancient shore,
And India will sing once more.
Lift her heart with sacred flame,
Let her song proclaim Your Name.
Verse 2
Through Kashmir’s mist and fields of gold,
Through jasmine winds and stories old,
Your Spirit moves, Your voice is near,
You dry each sorrow, crush each fear.
Pre-Chorus
Through storm and fire, through darkest pain,
Your love will rise and break her chains.
Chorus
Let the rivers roar and mountains rise,
Let the thunder shake the skies.
Your love has claimed this ancient shore,
And India will sing once more.
Lift her heart with sacred flame,
Let her song proclaim Your Name.
Bridge
No night too dark, no chain too strong,
Your victory has led her song.
The dawn will break, the grave will fall,
India will rise to heed Your call.
Final Chorus
Let the rivers roar and mountains rise,
Let the thunder shake the skies.
Your love has claimed this ancient shore,
And India will sing once more.
Lift her heart with sacred flame,
Let her song proclaim Your Name.

signal.title: Slayer of the Grave
signal.lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Darkness fell, the stone was sealed,
Hope lay buried, cold and still.
Tombs rejoiced, the serpent laughed,
'Til the thunder split the black.
(Pre-Chorus)
Chains are shattered, death undone,
The grave cannot hold the Risen Son!
(Chorus 1)
Slayer of the grave
Breaker of tombs!
Conqueror of death
Risen from the shattered tomb!
Slayer of the grave
Crushing hell’s domain,
Crowned with glory,
Forever He reigns!
(Verse 2)
Shadows fled at His command,
Keys of death now in His hand.
Sin defeated, wrath disarmed,
By nail-pierced hands, forever scarred.
(Pre-Chorus)
Chains are shattered, death undone,
The grave cannot hold the Risen Son!

Slayer of the grave
Breaker of chains!
Conqueror of death
Risen from the shattered tomb!
Slayer of the grave
Crushing hell’s domain,

O shattered gates! O broken tomb!

O fearful grave, behold your shame
Your sting is lost, erased by His Name!

Slayer of the grave
Breaker of death!
Conqueror of death
Risen from the shattered tomb!
Slayer of the grave
Crushing hell’s domain,
Crowned with glory,
Forever He reigns!

released.title: Let My People Go
released.lyrics:
Go DOWN, Moses!
Burn through Egypt’s gates,
Pharaoh’s throne is shaking,
Cause freedom’s on its way!

Chains on the innocent,
Crushed in a starving land,
Israel crying out,
No strength left to stand.
Oppression on their backs,
The fire in their bones,
God heard every tear,
And thunder shook the throne!

A whisper turned to a roar,
A calling carved into stone…

Go down, Moses!
Deep into the darkness, stand!
Face that Pharaoh,
Say the word of Heaven’s command!
Go down, Moses,
Break the yoke and shatter the hold!
Tell that tyrant,
GOD says let My people GO!

Moses stepped in unafraid,
Storm in his spirit rose,
Spoke the Name of Yahweh,
And shook the earth below.
Pharaoh with a hardened heart,
Defiant in his pride,
But judgment like a tidal wave
Was rolling in the sky!

A whisper turned to a roar,
A calling carved into stone…

Go down, Moses!
Deep into the darkness, stand!
Face that Pharaoh,
Say the word of Heaven’s command!
Go down, Moses,
Break the yoke and shatter the hold!
Tell that tyrant,
GOD says let My people GO!

LET… THEM… GO!
(Tremble, Pharaoh, your kingdom’s falling)
LET… THEM… GO!
(The chains you forged are breaking open)
LET… THEM… GO!
(Yahweh’s voice is thunder spoken)
LET MY PEOPLE GO!

Go down, Moses!
Stand where warriors never stand,
Speak the freedom
Written by the Lord’s own hand!
Go down, Moses,
Break the chains and lift the low!
Tell that tyrant,
GOD says LET MY PEOPLE GO!
released.songMeaning:
A cry that shook a nation. A command that broke chains.

God saw the suffering. God heard the cries. He sent one man straight into the center of power with a message no king could ignore. Barefoot. Stuttering. Wanted for murder. Walked right into the throne room of the most powerful empire on earth.

“Let My people go.”

That was not a request. That was Heaven breaking in.

We wrote this because that story is not old. There are still Pharaohs. Still systems. Still chains. And God is still the One who hears every cry, counts every brick, and decides when it ends.

If you feel held down, held back, or held captive, pay attention.

scripture.quote: Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.'
